newsitem.title: USA: Glenborough files $250 mln shelf stock offer.
newsitem.headline: Glenborough files $250 mln shelf stock offer.

text.p: Glenborough Realty Trust Inc filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday for the offering of up to $250 million in common stock and warrants.
The San Mateo, Calif.,-based real estate investment trust said net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including the acquisition and development of properties and repayment of debt.
No underwriters were listed in the filing.
